disposition_reason: The paper contains an ordered consciousness-state prediction task in Figure 5 with a published random-forest baseline. This design scopes the comparison to the complete original Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out result in Figure 5b,c, including all 19 subjects and its required source controls/companion metrics. Original label/timing bindings, classifier replay and calibrated sampling remain unresolved; the local state-contrast evaluator does not implement this task. No readiness is claimed.

source_paper.title: Measuring the dynamic balance of integration and segregation underlying consciousness, anesthesia, and sleep in humans

evidence.locator: Figure 5b,c,i,j and Results describing predictive power; Methods: Training and evaluation of machine learning models
evidence.supports: Original consciousness-state prediction uses balanced accuracy/AUC, subject-level validation and cross-dataset tests. Dataset-1 random forest reaches reported balanced accuracy 93% and AUC 0.984.

evidence.locator: Methods: Dataset-1; Dataset-2; fMRI data preprocessing and regional time course extraction; Training and evaluation of machine learning models
evidence.supports: Primary-article XML establishes original cohorts, paired preprocessing, network features, state exclusions and classifier settings. Dataset-2 training-state names require reconciliation with the stated awake/LOR class sampling.

evidence.locator: Version 1 description and Raw Data.zip metadata, file 47912122; DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.26367193.v1
evidence.supports: Five released datasets have paired GSR/noGSR MAT files. Dataset-1 is 19 participants x 8370 TRs x 450 ROIs; Dataset-2 is 26 x 5576 x 450. Metadata does not expose per-participant responsiveness annotations.
Integration averages binary-graph efficiency on noGSR correlations over thresholds 0.01 through 1.00; segregation averages clustering on GSR correlations; ISD subtracts the two.
The inspected repository documents network-measure, metastability and complexity computation; it does not establish a reproduced Figure 5 classifier.

target.description: Predict behaviorally assessed awake versus loss-of-responsiveness states for the complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out result. This is an explicitly scoped paper result; transition-only and cross-dataset panels are separate original results and need not all be surpassed to claim this scope.

dataset.description: Use original Dataset-1 paired GSR/noGSR regional BOLD arrays from Figshare 26367193 version 1 for the declared Figure 5b,c result. Dataset-2 is required only for a separately predeclared source panel that uses it; Dataset-3/4/5 static contrasts do not substitute.

cohort.description: Retain all 19 original analyzed Dataset-1 subjects for the declared full LOSO panel. No easier subject/state/window subset may be selected after outcomes. A separately declared transfer or Dataset-2 panel must retain its complete original population, including all 26 Dataset-2 subjects where applicable.

split.description: Preserve original Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out validation, stable-state training, transition exclusions and sample-selection protocol. Recover historical samples/seeds or document source-conformant stochastic reruns with provenance, predeclared calibration tolerance and paired candidate-author evaluation. A new nested, held-animal or pooled-window protocol is an extension. Dataset-2 training-state ambiguity must be resolved if a panel using Dataset-2 is separately declared.

inputs.description: Original classifier uses integration and segregation from whole brain plus eight networks (18 features). For every subject in the declared complete panel, bind awake/LOR labels and the responsiveness times needed for original training/evaluation exclusions to released arrays; metadata alone does not establish this mapping.

preprocessing.description: Preserve original 450-ROI extraction, Pearson dynamic connectivity in 4-minute windows stepping by one TR, and paired GSR/noGSR processing. Efficiency uses noGSR and clustering uses GSR, averaged over thresholds 0.01 through 1.00. Transition times and behavioral labels are targets, not predictor features.

metric.description: Balanced accuracy = (sensitivity + specificity)/2, higher is better; ROC AUC remains a separate reported endpoint. Static ISD and state-contrast significance are not classification accuracy.

aggregation.description: For the declared complete Dataset-1 LOSO result, preserve source mean across all 19 subjects and report ROC AUC separately from balanced accuracy. Other original panels retain their own aggregation if prospectively declared. Time windows within a participant do not create independent subjects.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 5b,c complete Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out awake/LOR balanced accuracy across all 19 subjects, with ROC AUC and required source controls retained

published_baseline.description: For the declared Dataset-1 Figure 5b,c result, reported random-forest balanced accuracy is 93% and companion AUC is 0.984. Recover available source precision or justify stochastic replay calibration against these rounded anchors. The approximately 75% cross-dataset and 87% transition results are distinct scopes, not interchangeable baselines or universal prerequisites.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No source-author classifier replay for the declared complete panel is established. Methods gives 100 trees and five randomly considered features per split. Historical stochastic draws may be recovered or rerun under the original protocol/population with seed/sample provenance, predeclared calibration tolerance and paired candidate-author evaluation; the local ISD kernel is not this baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: No source-backed practically meaningful balanced-accuracy increment is established. Resolve the rounded reference and variation across subjects before predeclaring an effect requirement; a universal percentage-point margin would be invented.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired candidate-minus-author uncertainty across all original subjects in the declared complete panel, respecting within-subject temporal dependence, overlapping LOSO fits and any documented source-conformant stochastic sampling. Source SEM is not itself a candidate-comparison decision rule; unrelated panels are separate scopes.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant, with all time windows kept together; datasets remain separate
uncertainty.rationale: Highly overlapping BOLD windows cannot be treated as independent samples, and LOSO fit overlap requires an explicitly justified comparison procedure.

paper_win_requires: Before candidate outcomes are examined, bind the complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset-1 LOSO panel as the claimed scope, including all 19 subjects, source state/window definitions, required original controls and companion ROC AUC. Report exactly which source result is surpassed.

Recover and reproduce the original state-label/time mapping, feature definitions, LOSO and sample-selection protocol and author random forest. Historical draws may be unavailable: documented source-conformant stochastic reruns are admissible with provenance, predeclared calibration tolerance and paired candidate-author evaluation on the same draws.

The candidate must surpass the source-paper balanced-accuracy result itself for the declared complete panel (reported 93%) at recovered source precision under a predeclared justified stochastic-calibration tolerance, as well as improve meaningfully over the calibrated author rerun with valid paired subject-level uncertainty. A weaker author rerun cannot lower the source target or make a candidate below the source result a paper win. Satisfy the panel's predeclared source controls and companion-metric requirements; merely reporting the candidate's relation to 93% is insufficient.

A different complete original Figure 5 panel can define a separately scoped comparison only when declared before candidate outcomes and retaining all its original participants, conditions, controls and metrics. Do not select an easier subject/window/state subset or favorable panel after seeing results; unrelated transition/transfer panels are not universal prerequisites.

Do not claim a win from stronger ISD state separation, smaller p-values, a Dataset-3/4/5-only classifier, pooled random windows or a changed nested/held-animal split protocol. Documented random redraws within the original protocol differ from these extensions.
Keep AUC, balanced accuracy and static ISD distinct and report source-paper, calibrated author-rerun and candidate scores separately.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA source comparison was performed.

episode.improvement_loop: After source recovery and admission, iterate using only permitted training/development feedback under a declared total search budget. Bind the complete original panel, controls, companion metrics, original stochastic sampling procedure and cumulative access before candidate outcomes; no posthoc panel narrowing.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze the declared complete source panel, feature extraction, model, hyperparameters, sampling/seed policy, calibration tolerance, code and preprocessing before assessment. Resolve historical public-result exposure and original hyperparameter-selection handling; do not replace LOSO with a new nested or held-animal protocol.
episode.final_evaluation: Owner runs the frozen candidate and recovered author classifier on all subjects/folds of the predeclared original panel. Use historical samples or documented source-conformant stochastic draws, paired across candidate and author; report subject-level outcomes, required controls and companion metrics without iterative assessment feedback. Claim only this scoped source result.
episode.baseline_policy: Published panel-specific scores, a calibrated source-conformant author rerun and current SOTA are distinct. Exact historical stochastic membership is not mandatory when original protocol/population, provenance and predeclared calibration tolerance are preserved. The local state-contrast evaluator remains calibration only; changed split protocols are extensions.

blocking_issues: Bind authentic responsiveness labels and times for every subject/state/window needed by the predeclared full Dataset-1 LOSO panel; do not select only readily mapped subjects.

Recover the original sampling procedure and either historical draws or a documented source-conformant stochastic rerun policy with provenance and predeclared calibration tolerance. Resolve Dataset-2 training-state ambiguity only if a separate declared panel uses it.

Recover available precision for the scoped 93% balanced-accuracy and 0.984 AUC anchors and bind the panel's required source controls/companion metrics. Other transition/transfer scores are necessary only for claims scoped to those results.
Build and validate the original classifier/evaluator for the complete declared panel rather than treating the ISD kernel as a prediction benchmark.
Qualify paired participant-level uncertainty, meaningful effect, calibrated baseline agreement, equal access and concrete cumulative resource/search budgets before activation.

legacy.notes: Preserve initial-evaluator-v1 ISD calculations and prospective paired state contrasts. Its Dataset-3/5 policy, withheld Dataset-4 and hypothetical classifier proposal do not implement Figure 5 and cannot establish improvement over the paper.
